text:
kai: Quickly ran an nsys profile for the KV-prefetch experiment on nightly.

kai: Command:
```bash
nsys profile --output=kv_prefetch_run1 --trace=nvtx,cuda --sample=none --stats=true 
    --capture-range=cudaProfilerApi --capture-range-end=stop ./serve_bench --config=kv_prefetch.json
```

maria: initial waterfall shows a huge gap around prefetch_kv_copy_v3 — ~46% GPU time.

jonathan: Can you paste the kernel leaderboard? :eyes:

kai: Kernel top 5 from the summary (wall-time%):
- prefetch_kv_copy_v3 46.1%
- attn_gemm_small_seq 18.4%
- kv_pack_unpack 9.7%
- softmax_stable 7.3%
- memmove_parallel 5.6%

sree: That prefetch kernel dominating is new compared to last week's. Could be a change in batching heuristics (smaller batch windows -> more prefix copies).

maria: Looking at SM utilization in the timeline, prefetch shows very low occupancy but high SM active time -> warp inefficiency.

jonathan: Hypothesis: uncoalesced loads due to changed layout in KV cache after the KV-shuffle PR. Any repro config?

kai: Repro command used:
```json
{"model":"redwood-13b", "max_seq":1024, "batch_sizes":[1,2,4,8], "kv_layout":"packed-v2"}
```

maria: Can you attach the perfetto flame (link) and nvtx markers? perf-bot: uploaded perfetto link.

perf-bot: perfetto trace: https://perfetto.redwood/trace/abcd1234 (uploaded)

sree: From the flame, prefetch_kv_copy spans many small launches. Suggest combining launches and using coalesced memcpy or cudaMemcpyAsync with pinned staging.

jonathan: Also check kernel selection — runtime seems to pick the 'v3' prefetch which isn't vectorized. We can try forcing 'v2' to compare.

kai: Quick local experiment: forcing v2 drops prefetch time to 12% and overall p50 latency by 18ms. Will open a tiny PR to toggle default heuristic.

maria: Nice. Please include nsys counters (L2 hit rate, gld/gst) in PR comment.

jonathan: I'll add a regression test to ensure batcher doesn't regress to tiny micro-batches that trigger this path.

sree: TL;DR: root cause likely KV-layout change + batch windowing -> unvectorized prefetch kernel. Plan: PR to revert default, perf test, add assertion in batcher.

kai: Opening PR now. Thanks all :thumbsup:
